serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: I live nearby. What are you people doing here? Hobo: And how does it look like we are doing? You: … Hobo: My new group is taking over this place! You: Your new group? Hobo: Yes. After struggling alone for such a long time I decided to join forces with like-minded people. Hobo: If one of us gets attacked, the others are gonna help him. Good idea, right? Damn, they are organized. It’s even harder than I expected. You: Listen, I don't mean to sound like a dick, but can’t you people move somewhere else? #Hobo.Face.angry Hobo: And what do you mean by ‘you people’?! Huh? You: Ugh…{{wi}} You, homeless? Hobo: Oh, wow. Really? ‘Homeless’ in this day and age?! You: What’s wrong with it? Hobo: Me and our people decided that it’s offensive! We call ourselves ‘unhoused folk’ now. It’s much less defining and it conveys that our predicament is only temporary! You: You can’t be serious. If I remember correctly you called yourself homeless when we first met! Hobo: Y-Yeah?! And what of it? Back then I wasn't as educated as I am now about our class-struggle! You: Yeah, right. Hobo: You don’t believe me? Here! Read our manifesto! You: Ugh! Is that a napkin from a certain fast food chain? Why is it wet… Hobo: It just so happens that our best writer has a chronic runny nose. You: Great. Hobo: Stop criticizing and start reading! Maybe then you will understand us better! You: ‘We were all dreamers once. Arcitects (a typo I guess) of success, backstabbed by the society! By the same society that now makes segmented benches! That closes public parks at night! That puts fences under bridges!’ You: ‘It’s time for our people to unite under one banner! As the homelessness unhousness is on the rise, we are becoming a voting bloc that can no longer be ignored! It’s time to leave our every-man-for-himself mentalitybehind us and stand united!’ You: That’s great and all, but could you guys move somewhere else? At least for a few weeks so that this building can be sold. Hobo: No way! That’s the last apartment complex that still has a steam boiler! You see these vents? Thanks to them we aren’t cold at night! What should I do? It would be immoral to just kick them out. What if one of them freezes to death? On the other hand, I really want to leave this place…
